implementationStateAtFreeze: no S12 trajectory had been executed; split, estimand, cost, precision, multiplicity, and decision rules were frozen from S01-S11 and E01/E02 evidence only
frozenQuestion: Do the prespecified S06 active-rescue and S09 target-aware engineered mechanisms retain useful performance on immutable S12 holdouts spanning damage, location, size, runtime process, scheduler, and target change without any holdout-driven tuning?

includedMechanisms.status: supported only versus passive and sham; explicitly constrained by null comparisons to recovery-time/opportunity/energy-matched controls
includedMechanisms.claimBoundary: engineered one-shot local repair; no biological rescue claim

includedMechanisms.status: supported versus outcome-blind signal/information/cost-matched nonadaptive control
includedMechanisms.claimBoundary: engineered target-code access and adaptation; no spontaneous inference

excludedFromTransferPortfolio: S07 bounded local-memory variants: null against matched controls
S08 plastic modes: prespecified recovery and stability harms
S10 repeated-injury history effects: operational exposure finding, not a portable controller
S11 native Selection-cursor reset: boundary-specific state localization, not a portable repair mechanism
priorEvidenceConstraints.exposureStatement: All mechanisms are hand-designed and previously exposed; there is no learned model, parameter training, fitting, or controller search in S12.

inherits.checkpoint: exact post-completion checkpoint after absorbing-target certificate and uniform two-opportunities-per-identity stabilization capped at 20*n
inherits.sharedPrefix: arms share exact source checkpoint, lesion/change state, scenario, global event clock, native internal state, ledger, and counter addresses until arm-specific behavior diverges
inherits.schedulerPairingBoundary: within-family arms are counter-address paired; cross-family scheduler comparisons are scenario-paired RNG-unpaired
inherits.dynamicRngBoundary: S04 intermittent stream remains isolated and counter-addressed; fatigue is an endogenous mediator and owns no random stream

immutableSplit.unit: fully specified scenario before any S12 trajectory outcome exists

heldOutAxes.joint: held-out size crossed with held-out scheduler and fault; damage uses off-center local scrambling and goals use held-out target changes

leakageProhibition: No holdout outcome may change a mechanism, target map, split, duration assignment, threshold, endpoint, subgroup, multiplicity family, or decision rule.
No controller may be selected using S12 calibration or holdout outcomes; the S06 and S09 mechanisms are fixed before S12.
Implementation debugging may correct contract violations only; every failed execution attempt is logged and the specification hash cannot change after the first S12 trajectory.

damageContract.selectedIdentity: identity occupying floor((n-1)/2) immediately after lesion
damageContract.lesionSeverity: window length round_half_up(0.4*n), minimum 2; location variants use the same length and therefore the same reversal inversion severity
damageContract.activeArm: one-shot S06 local repair with unit action and abstract-energy budgets
damageContract.matchedArm: one-shot recovery-time/opportunity/energy-matched control using durations assigned from the immutable S06 calibration active-run bank before S12 outcomes
damageContract.durationBankSelection: filter split=calibration and arm=active_assisted_rescue; choose a donor by counter hash within policy/direction and nearest source-size stratum; scale donor duration by n/donor_n with round-half-up, minimum one
damageContract.capabilityBoundary: S06 active-versus-sham evidence is reported from S06 and is not re-estimated as the S12 transfer estimand

goalContract.activeArm: target-aware controller emits the target-code candidate
goalContract.matchedArm: nonadaptive controller receives the same signal, constructs the same shadow candidate, pays the same reads/comparisons/abstract-energy cost, and emits the native proposal
goalContract.changeTiming: instantaneous at the exact stabilized post-completion checkpoint with no clock, stream, ledger, or internal-state advance
goalContract.targetPermission: only records already authorized by the native policy may have value projected to the frozen target code; no target position, global progress, or hidden target access

runtimeProcesses.intermittent_movement_markov_1_16_1_4_v1: S04 exogenous two-state process with available-to-failed hazard 1/16 and failed-to-available hazard 1/4 on the isolated S04 stream
runtimeProcesses.movement_fatigue_threshold_3_cooldown_8_: S04 endogenous mediator; every accepted movement participation increments load, threshold three causes eight-opportunity movement unavailability, no exogenous draws

estimands.population: every assigned scenario, including construction/stabilization failures, phase-budget failures, quiescent failures, and censors
estimands.primaryEndpoint: paired success risk difference, active minus matched control
estimands.restrictedTimeEndpoint: paired restricted time difference with failure/censor encoded as budget+1
estimands.generalizationGap: held-out paired risk difference minus calibration paired risk difference for the same mechanism
secondaryEndpoints: distance AUC normalized by phase budget and maximum distance
no-change intact-target departure and final retention
native activations, proposals, accepted swaps, reads, comparisons, suppressed native opportunities, unit action, and abstract-energy costs
estimands.competingTerminalRule: retain terminal category; count success only when the frozen target is reached within budget; encode all other terminals/censors as restricted time budget+1 without imputation or survivor conditioning
estimands.stabilityRule: no-change target-aware versus matched nonadaptive probes for 20*n opportunities; any target departure is harm

inference.precisionRule: an aggregate or subgroup is precise only when its paired risk-difference bootstrap 95% interval half-width is <=0.10 and it has at least 48 complete assigned pairs; otherwise label inconclusive without exclusion
inference.transferRule: generalization-gap lower 95% simultaneous bound >-0.10 and no multiplicity-adjusted stability harm

multiplicity.benefit: Holm family across all mechanism-by-held-out-axis primary success contrasts
multiplicity.generalization: Holm family across all one-sided noninferiority gap tests
multiplicity.stability: separate Holm family across all no-change harm contrasts
multiplicity.subgroups: descriptive precision-labeled only; no confirmatory subgroup promotion

overallClassification.supportive: validation passes and at least one mechanism passes its joint holdout plus at least three single-axis transfer tests, with no adjusted stability harm
overallClassification.null: validation passes but no mechanism meets the supportive rule and no prespecified calibration-supported mechanism shows adjusted holdout harm
overallClassification.constraining/contradictory: a calibration-supported mechanism shows adjusted holdout harm, a semantic/validation contract fails, or transfer is materially worse than the frozen margin

requiredAudits: immutable split hash and zero overlap

claimBoundary: S12 tests transfer of two prespecified hand-designed simulator interventions over a frozen synthetic panel. It does not train a controller, establish biological repair or learning, or justify unseen real-world generalization.
